title: RECREG: Recovery-based Shielding for Regular Safety Properties in Reinforcement Learning

paragraphs.en: In many real-world scenarios we need to consider formal requirements, such as safety and constraint compliance, to deploy Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents. In this paper we introduce RecReg , a safe RL framework capable of enforcing non-Markovian regular safety properties via recovery-based shielding. RecReg is a unified approach that supports different levels of a priori knowledge and safety guarantees. The paper primarily focuses on building the theoretical foundations for RecReg in the tabular setting, providing rigorous safety and convergence guarantees that are not present in related work. We provide an extensive set of empirical results using the MASA-Safe-RL library, and we outline an extension of RecReg to deep RL domains using SOTA model-based RL. Our empirical results demonstrate that RecReg achieves efficient learning and matches the theory in this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 在许多现实世界中，我们需要考虑正式要求（例如安全性和约束合规性），才能部署强化学习（RL）智能体。 本文提出了 RecReg——一种安全的 RL 框架，能够通过基于恢复的屏蔽机制强制执行非马尔可夫正则安全属性。 RecReg 是一种统一的方法，支持不同层次的事先知识和安全保证。 本文主要关注在表格设置中构建 RecReg 的理论基础，提供了相关工作中所不具备的严格安全性和收敛性保证。 我们使用 MASA-Safe-RL 库提供了一系列全面的实证结果，并概述了利用 SOTA 模型 기반 RL 将 RecReg 扩展到深度 RL 领域的方法。 我们的实证结果表明，RecReg 实现了高效学习，并与本文的理论分析一致。

paragraphs.en: Safe Reinforcement Learning (RL) is an active area of research focusing on the training of agents with RL while maintaining some standard of safe behaviour at deployment and possibly during training as well [ 5 ] . There exist many competing paradigms in safe RL, the most common being Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) [ 4 ] , which frame safe RL as a constrained optimization problem, enforcing safety through cost functions and expected cumulative cost thresholds; although this approach is often inappropriate in highly safety-critical domains, as it only enforces safety in expectation and often lacks rigorous guarantees [ 53 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 安全强化学习（Safe Reinforcement Learning，RL）是一个活跃的研究领域，其核心是在利用强化学习训练智能体的同时，确保其在部署阶段以及可能的训练阶段都能维持一定标准的安全行为 [ 5 ]。 安全强化学习中存在多种相互竞争的范式，其中最常见的是约束马尔可夫决策过程（Constrained Markov Decision Processes，CMDPs）[ 4]。该范式将安全强化学习表述为一个约束优化问题，通过成本函数和预期累积成本阈值来强制执行安全性；然而，这种方法在高度依赖安全的领域往往并不适用，因为它仅能保证预期的安全性，且通常缺乏严谨的理论保障 [ 53]。

sents.en: Safe Reinforcement Learning (RL) is an active area of research focusing on the training of agents with RL while maintaining some standard of safe behaviour at deployment and possibly during training as well [ 5 ] .
sents.zh: 安全强化学习（Safe Reinforcement Learning，RL）是一个活跃的研究领域，其核心是在利用强化学习训练智能体的同时，确保其在部署阶段以及可能的训练阶段都能维持一定标准的安全行为 [ 5 ]。

sents.en: There exist many competing paradigms in safe RL, the most common being Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) [ 4 ] , which frame safe RL as a constrained optimization problem, enforcing safety through cost functions and expected cumulative cost thresholds; although this approach is often inappropriate in highly safety-critical domains, as it only enforces safety in expectation and often lacks rigorous guarantees [ 53 ] .

paragraphs.en: An alternative view comes from formal methods . Methods from this class often leverage some form of Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) [ 42 ] to express formal safety constraints and task objectives, enabling expressive and interpretable specifications [ 25 , 26 , 14 , 53 , 54 , 47 , 40 ] . Following this line of work, shielding has emerged as a powerful approach for enforcing LTL safety properties in RL [ 3 ] . Predicated on ideas like the Simplex Architecture [ 46 ] , shielding works by monitoring the agent’s actions and overriding them with a safe alternative if they propose an action that could lead to a safety violation. Classical approaches to shielding leverage reactive synthesis to build correct-by-construction monitors from formal safety specification and a formal model of the environment called the safety abstraction [ 10 , 3 ] . The safety abstraction is designed to encode the minimum amount of environment dynamics required to guarantee safety. As such, it is often built from a pessimistic view of the environment derived from prior knowledge, thus classical shielding approaches can only reasonably be applied to known environments or simple safety specifications. This fundamentally departs from the usual RL framework (unknown environment), but does provide strong safety guarantees by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种观点来自形式方法。 这类方法通常利用某种形式的线性时态逻辑（LTL）[42] 来表达形式化的安全约束和任务目标，从而实现具有高度表达力和可解释性的规范 [25, 26, 14, 53, 54, 47, 40]。 沿着这一研究路线，屏蔽技术已成为在强化学习中强制执行 LTL 安全属性的一种有效方法 [3]。 屏蔽技术基于诸如单纯形架构 [46] 之类的思想，通过监控智能体的行为，并在其拟采取的行动可能导致安全违规时，用安全的替代行动进行覆盖。 经典的屏蔽方法利用反应性合成，从形式化的安全规范和被称为“安全抽象”的形式化环境模型出发，构建出“按设计正确”的监控器 [10, 3]。 安全抽象的设计旨在编码保证安全所需的最少环境动态信息。 因此，它通常基于先验知识对环境的悲观看法来构建，这使得经典屏蔽方法只能合理地应用于已知环境或简单的安全规范。 这与常规的强化学习框架（未知环境）存在根本差异，但确实通过其设计提供了强有力的安全保证。

paragraphs.en: More recent shielding approaches consider probabilistic safety constraints [ 32 , 24 ] . While these are less pessimistic, they still require knowledge of the transition kernel, using probabilistic model checking to verify actions. There has however been a shift to lift these assumptions, in particular, by leveraging model-based RL to estimate the unknown environment dynamics and verify actions via forward simulation in the latent space of a recurrent state space model [ 27 , 57 , 16 , 17 ] , with Gaussian Process dynamics models [ 18 ] or ensembles of probabilistic neural networks [ 20 ] . RecReg addresses this same question: how can we obtain meaningful safety guarantees when the environment dynamics are unknown? . We summarize our contributions hereafter.
paragraphs.zh: 较新的屏蔽方法考虑了概率性安全约束 [ 32 , 24 ] 。 尽管这些方法没有那么悲观，但它们仍然需要知道转移核，并通过概率模型检查来验证动作。 然而，研究重点已转向消除这些假设，特别是通过利用基于模型的学习（model-based RL）来估计未知的环境动态，并通过在循环状态空间模型的潜在空间中执行前向模拟来验证动作 [ 27 , 57 , 16 , 17 ] ，其中使用了高斯过程动态模型 [ 18 ] 或概率神经网络的集成 [ 20 ] 。 RecReg 也解决了同样的问题：当环境动态未知时，我们如何获得有意义的安全保障？ 下文我们将总结我们的贡献。

sents.zh: 下文我们将总结我们的贡献。

paragraphs.en: To bridge the gap between the strong empirical results achievable by data driven methods (e.g., CMDP, model-based RL) and formally guaranteed safety (classical shielding) we propose RecReg , a unified framework for enforcing regular safety properties that spans multiple levels of a priori knowledge. In a similar fashion to Recovery RL [ 49 ] , RecReg learns a backup policy trained to maximize safety probability and action replacement (shielding) is implemented by identifying probabilistic safe sets (or “recovery zones”). A central contribution of this paper is in the development of explicit safety guarantees, convergence and optimality results which are missing in prior work [ 49 ] . In particular, we identify and formalize three complementary operation modes. In the Exact mode, RecReg assumes full knowledge of the transition kernel and guarantees safety from the beginning of training. In the ModelBased mode, RecReg estimates the transition kernel from observed data, then performs on-the-fly verification via finite-horizon reachability analysis, enabling principled shielding under partial model knowledge with statistical guarantees. In the ModelFree mode, RecReg dispenses with explicit model learning altogether and instead directly estimates the safety critic, yielding a purely model-free shielding mechanism with convergence guarantees. We also use DreamerV3 [ 23 ] to develop a deep RL variant of RecReg that uses latent rollout models and safety critics to provide safety guarantees under correct model calibration. In the tabular setting, we validate that RecReg matches the outlined theory and that comparable approaches cannot reliably enforce safety constraints while maximising task performance. In deep RL we also observe that RecReg is able to reliably reduce safety violations while achieving good returns compared to similar approaches based on the DreamerV3 architecture. Together these results establish RecReg as a practical and theoretically-grounded approach to safe RL
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥合数据驱动方法（例如 CMDP、基于模型的强化学习）所能实现的强大经验结果与形式化保障的安全性（经典屏蔽）之间的差距，我们提出了 RecReg——一个统一的框架，用于强制执行正则安全性属性，并涵盖了多个先验知识层次。 与 Recovery RL [49] 类似，RecReg 会学习一个旨在最大化安全概率的备用策略，并通过识别概率安全集（或“恢复区域”）来实现动作替换（屏蔽）。 本文的核心贡献在于提出了明确的安全性保障、收敛性和最优性结果，而这些在先前工作 [49] 中是缺失的。 具体而言，我们识别并形式化了三种互补的操作模式。 在精确模式下，RecReg 假设完全了解转移核，并从训练一开始就保证安全性。 在基于模型模式下，RecReg 从观测数据中估计转移核，然后通过有限时域可达性分析进行实时验证，从而在部分模型知识下以统计保障的方式实现有原则的屏蔽。 在无模型模式下，RecReg 完全摒弃了显式的模型学习，转而直接估计安全性评判器，从而获得一个具有收敛保障的纯无模型屏蔽机制。 我们还利用 DreamerV3 [23] 开发了一种 RecReg 的深度强化学习变体，该变体使用潜在展开模型和安全性评判器，在模型校准正确时提供安全性保障。 在表格设置中，我们验证了 RecReg 与所提出的理论一致，而类似方法无法在最大化任务性能的同时可靠地强制执行安全约束。 在深度强化学习中，我们还观察到，与基于 DreamerV3 架构的类似方法相比，RecReg 能够在可靠减少安全性违规的同时实现良好的回报。 这些结果共同确立了 RecReg 作为一种兼具实用性和理论基础的可靠强化学习方法。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods for safe RL can roughly be dividing into two camps: ( A ) methods that incorporate safety into the learning objective, encouraging safe behaviour as an outcome of learning [ 13 , 38 , 48 , 45 , 6 , 2 , 60 , 25 , 47 ] , and ( B ) methods that enforce safety via external mechanisms that directly modify the agent’s actions [ 3 , 32 , 35 , 9 , 49 , 36 , 20 ] . Methods from camp ( B ) make up a large portion of “provably safe“ RL algorithms [ 37 ] . They can also be further divided into hard constraints [ 3 ] and probabilistic constraints [ 32 , 9 , 24 ] . Methods based on CMDPs are from camp ( A ) – they use a cost function, that often represents safety violations, in the learning objective to reduce the probability of unsafe behaviour. CMDPs themselves can be solved via linear programming in the tabular setting [ 4 ] . For more complex environments, methods based on Lagrange relaxations and dual-gradient descent [ 13 , 38 , 48 , 45 , 6 ] , and local policy search with gradient projections [ 2 , 60 ] are popular approaches. While CMDPs provide a convenient framework for learning, they have several limitations. In particular, safety constraints are only enforced in expectation, which do not guarantee that unsafe events will never occur. Furthermore, the discounting accumulated costs also poses issues with constraining limiting behaviour [ 53 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 现有的安全强化学习方法大致可分为两类：（A）将安全性融入学习目标的方法，通过学习的结果来鼓励安全行为 [ 13 , 38 , 48 , 45 , 6 , 2 , 60 , 25 , 47 ]；以及（B）通过外部机制直接修改智能体动作以强制执行安全性的方法 [ 3 , 32 , 35 , 9 , 49 , 36 , 20 ]。 （B）类方法构成了“可证明安全”强化学习算法的大部分内容 [ 37 ]。 它们还可以进一步分为硬性约束 [ 3 ] 和概率性约束 [ 32 , 9 , 24 ]。 基于 CMDP 的方法属于（A）类——它们在学习目标中使用一个成本函数（通常代表安全违规）来降低不安全行为发生的概率。 在表格环境中，CMDP 本身可以通过线性规划求解 [ 4 ]。 对于更复杂的环境，基于拉格朗日松弛和双梯度下降的方法 [ 13 , 38 , 48 , 45 , 6 ]，以及带有梯度投影的局部策略搜索方法 [ 2 , 60 ] 是常用的方案。 尽管 CMDP 为学习提供了一个便捷的框架，但它也存在一些局限性。 特别是，安全约束仅在期望意义上得到满足，这并不能保证不安全事件绝不会发生。 此外，对累积成本的折扣处理在约束极限行为时也存在问题 [ 53 ]。

sents.en: Existing methods for safe RL can roughly be dividing into two camps: ( A ) methods that incorporate safety into the learning objective, encouraging safe behaviour as an outcome of learning [ 13 , 38 , 48 , 45 , 6 , 2 , 60 , 25 , 47 ] , and ( B ) methods that enforce safety via external mechanisms that directly modify the agent’s actions [ 3 , 32 , 35 , 9 , 49 , 36 , 20 ] .
sents.zh: 现有的安全强化学习方法大致可分为两类：（A）将安全性融入学习目标的方法，通过学习的结果来鼓励安全行为 [ 13 , 38 , 48 , 45 , 6 , 2 , 60 , 25 , 47 ]；以及（B）通过外部机制直接修改智能体动作以强制执行安全性的方法 [ 3 , 32 , 35 , 9 , 49 , 36 , 20 ]。

sents.en: Methods from camp ( B ) make up a large portion of “provably safe“ RL algorithms [ 37 ] .
sents.zh: （B）类方法构成了“可证明安全”强化学习算法的大部分内容 [ 37 ]。

sents.en: They can also be further divided into hard constraints [ 3 ] and probabilistic constraints [ 32 , 9 , 24 ] .
sents.zh: 它们还可以进一步分为硬性约束 [ 3 ] 和概率性约束 [ 32 , 9 , 24 ]。

sents.en: Methods based on CMDPs are from camp ( A ) – they use a cost function, that often represents safety violations, in the learning objective to reduce the probability of unsafe behaviour.
sents.zh: 基于 CMDP 的方法属于（A）类——它们在学习目标中使用一个成本函数（通常代表安全违规）来降低不安全行为发生的概率。

sents.en: CMDPs themselves can be solved via linear programming in the tabular setting [ 4 ] .
sents.zh: 在表格环境中，CMDP 本身可以通过线性规划求解 [ 4 ]。

sents.en: For more complex environments, methods based on Lagrange relaxations and dual-gradient descent [ 13 , 38 , 48 , 45 , 6 ] , and local policy search with gradient projections [ 2 , 60 ] are popular approaches.
sents.zh: 对于更复杂的环境，基于拉格朗日松弛和双梯度下降的方法 [ 13 , 38 , 48 , 45 , 6 ]，以及带有梯度投影的局部策略搜索方法 [ 2 , 60 ] 是常用的方案。

sents.en: While CMDPs provide a convenient framework for learning, they have several limitations.
sents.zh: 尽管 CMDP 为学习提供了一个便捷的框架，但它也存在一些局限性。

sents.en: In particular, safety constraints are only enforced in expectation, which do not guarantee that unsafe events will never occur.
sents.zh: 特别是，安全约束仅在期望意义上得到满足，这并不能保证不安全事件绝不会发生。

sents.en: Furthermore, the discounting accumulated costs also poses issues with constraining limiting behaviour [ 53 ] .
sents.zh: 此外，对累积成本的折扣处理在约束极限行为时也存在问题 [ 53 ]。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, our approach RecReg fits neatly into camp ( B ), enforcing regular safety properties (more expressive than LTL safety properties) with high probability. LTL constraints have been considered in RL for both task specification [ 25 , 26 , 14 ] and constraint specification [ 53 , 54 , 47 ] . LTL constraints are PAC learnable under specific conditions [ 59 , 53 ] , but optimality under LTL constraints can only be achieved subject to optimal discount factors and Lagrange multipliers [ 54 , 47 ] . Earlier theoretical work assumed access to a perfect generative model of the environment which can be queried from any state, breaking standard RL assumptions [ 53 ] . Recent work on Automata Constrained Q-learning uses reward shaping and penalties to ensure the optimal policy is also safe at convergence although does not provide explicit safety guarantees during learning unlike our approach [ 40 ] . For RL with LTL safety constraints, Shielding can be used to enforce constraint compliance [ 3 ] . In partially observable settings (e.g., deep RL) safety can be guaranteed if the underlying transition structure is known [ 12 ] . RecReg , by contrast, offers a unified framework for safety guarantees even when the transition dynamics or structure are truly unknown.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，我们的方法 RecReg 完全属于（B）阵营，能以高概率强制执行规则性安全属性（其表达能力强于 LTL 安全属性）。 LTL 约束已在强化学习中被用于任务规范 [25, 26, 14] 和约束规范 [53, 54, 47]。 LTL 约束在特定条件下是可 PAC 学习的 [59, 53]，但在 LTL 约束下达到最优性只能依赖于最优折扣因子和拉格朗日乘子 [54, 47]。 早期的理论工作假设可以访问环境的完美生成模型，该模型可从任何状态进行查询，这打破了标准强化学习的假设 [53]。 近期关于自动机约束 Q-learning 的研究通过奖励塑造和惩罚来确保最优策略在收敛时也是安全的，但与我们的方法不同，它并未在学习过程中提供明确的安全保证 [40]。 对于带有 LTL 安全约束的强化学习，可以使用“屏蔽”技术来强制执行约束合规性 [3]。 在部分可观测的设置中（例如深度强化学习），如果底层的转移结构已知，则安全性可以得到保证 [12]。 相比之下，RecReg 提供了一个统一的安全保证框架，即使转移动态或结构完全未知也能适用。

paragraphs.en: Another related line of research is Reward Machines [ 30 , 29 ] ; these are closely related to our work as simple reward machines can encode reward functions for learning regular safety properties. While the Reward Machines literature is primarily focused on task specification, there are many key insights such as counterfactual experiences and reward shaping [ 41 ] that are used to speed up learning over Reward Machines , which can applied in our framework too.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条相关的研究路线是奖励机（Reward Machines）[30, 29]；这些研究与我们的工作密切相关，因为简单的奖励机可以编码出用于学习常规安全属性的奖励函数。 尽管奖励机相关文献主要关注任务规范，但其中有许多关键见解，例如反事实经验和奖励塑造 [41]，这些方法可用于加速基于奖励机的学习过程，并且同样可以应用于我们的框架中。

paragraphs.en: We follow the usual convention of modelling the environment as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) ℳ = ( 𝖲 , 𝖠 , 𝖲 0 , 𝐏 , 𝐑 ) \mathcal{M}=(\mathsf{S},\mathsf{A},\mathsf{S}_{0},\mathbf{P},\mathbf{R}) , where 𝖲 \mathsf{S} and 𝖠 \mathsf{A} are finite sets of states and actions respectively; 𝖲 0 ⊆ 𝖲 \mathsf{S}_{0}\subseteq\mathsf{S} is the set of initial states; 𝐏 : 𝖲 × 𝖠 → D ⁡ ( 𝖲 ) \mathbf{P}:\mathsf{S}\times\mathsf{A}\to D(\mathsf{S}) is a (generally unknown) transition kernel; and 𝐑 : 𝖲 × 𝖠 × 𝖲 → ℝ \mathbf{R}:\mathsf{S}\times\mathsf{A}\times\mathsf{S}\to\mathbb{R} is a reward function. A solution for the RL problem can take the form of a (memoryless, stochastic) policy π : 𝖲 → D ⁡ ( 𝖠 ) \pi:\mathsf{S}\to D(\mathsf{A}) , which induces a Markov chain ℳ π \mathcal{M}_{\pi} with transition kernel 𝐏 π ​ ( s ′ | s ) = ∑ a ∈ 𝖠 π ⁡ ( a | s ) ​ 𝐏 ​ ( s ′ | s , a ) \mathbf{P}_{\pi}(s^{\prime}|s)=\sum_{a\in\mathsf{A}}\pi(a|s)\mathbf{P}(s^{\prime}|s,a) . We let Π \Pi denote the set of memoryless policies on 𝖲 \mathsf{S} . For a given discount factor γ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \gamma\in[0,1] , the value function of policy π \pi is the expected discount return V π ℳ ​ ( s ) = 𝔼 π ℳ ​ [ ∑ t = 0 ∞ γ t ​ 𝐑 ​ ( s t , a t , s t + 1 ) ∣ s 0 = s ] V^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}(s)=\mathbb{E}^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}\left[\sum^{\infty}_{t=0}\gamma^{t}\mathbf{R}(s_{t},a_{t},s_{t+1})\mid s_{0}=s\right] , where 𝔼 π ℳ \mathbb{E}^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi} denotes the expected value of following π \pi in ℳ \mathcal{M} . Similarly, the state-action value function or Q-function, is defined as Q π ℳ ( s , a ) = 𝔼 π ℳ [ ∑ t = 0 ∞ γ t R ( s , a , s ′ ) ∣ s 0 = s , a 0 = a ] Q^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}(s,a)=\mathbb{E}^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}[\sum^{\infty}_{t=0}\gamma^{t}R(s,a,s^{\prime})\mid s_{0}=s,a_{0}=a] . Hereafter we drop the superscript ℳ \mathcal{M} when it is clear from the context. The aim of RL is to find an optimal policy π ∗ \pi^{*} such that for all s ∈ 𝖲 s\in\mathsf{S} , we have π ∗ ( s ) = arg sup π ∈ Π V π ( s ) \pi^{*}(s)=\arg\sup_{\pi\in\Pi}V_{\pi}(s) . We write, V ∗ = max π ⁡ V π V^{*}=\max_{\pi}V_{\pi} and Q ∗ = max π ⁡ Q π Q^{*}=\max_{\pi}Q_{\pi} to denote the optimal value functions. Note that there always exists an optimal policy in Π \Pi [ 43 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循通常的惯例，将环境建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）ℳ = ( 𝖲 , 𝖠 , 𝖲 0 , 𝐏 , 𝐑 ) \mathcal{M}=(\mathsf{S},\mathsf{A},\mathsf{S}_{0},\mathbf{P},\mathbf{R})，其中 𝖲 \mathsf{S} 和 𝖠 \mathsf{A} 分别是状态和动作的有限集合；𝖲 0 ⊆ 𝖲 \mathsf{S}_{0}\subseteq\mathsf{S} 是初始状态的集合；𝐏 : 𝖲 × 𝖠 → D ⁡ ( 𝖲 ) \mathbf{P}:\mathsf{S}\times\mathsf{A}\to D(\mathsf{S}) 是一个（通常未知的）转移核；而 𝐑 : 𝖲 × 𝖠 × 𝖲 → ℝ \mathbf{R}:\mathsf{S}\times\mathsf{A}\times\mathsf{S}\to\mathbb{R} 是一个奖励函数。 强化学习问题的解可以表现为一个（无记忆、随机）策略 π : 𝖲 → D ⁡ ( 𝖠 ) \pi:\mathsf{S}\to D(\mathsf{A})，它诱导出一个马尔可夫链 ℳ π \mathcal{M}_{\pi}，其转移核为 𝐏 π ​ ( s ′ | s ) = ∑ a ∈ 𝖠 π ⁡ ( a | s ) ​ 𝐏 ​ ( s ′ | s , a ) \mathbf{P}_{\pi}(s^{\prime}|s)=\sum_{a\in\mathsf{A}}\pi(a|s)\mathbf{P}(s^{\prime}|s,a)。 我们用 Π \Pi 表示 𝖲 \mathsf{S} 上的无记忆策略集合。 对于给定的折扣因子 γ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \gamma\in[0,1]，策略 π \pi 的价值函数是期望折扣回报 V π ℳ ​ ( s ) = 𝔼 π ℳ ​ [ ∑ t = 0 ∞ γ t ​ 𝐑 ​ ( s t , a t , s t + 1 ) ∣ s 0 = s ] V^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}(s)=\mathbb{E}^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}\left[\sum^{\infty}_{t=0}\gamma^{t}\mathbf{R}(s_{t},a_{t},s_{t+1})\mid s_{0}=s\right]，其中 𝔼 π ℳ \mathbb{E}^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi} 表示在 ℳ \mathcal{M} 中遵循策略 π \pi 的期望值。 类似地，状态-动作价值函数或 Q 函数定义为 Q π ℳ ( s , a ) = 𝔼 π ℳ [ ∑ t = 0 ∞ γ t R ( s , a , s ′ ) ∣ s 0 = s , a 0 = a ] Q^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}(s,a)=\mathbb{E}^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}[\sum^{\infty}_{t=0}\gamma^{t}R(s,a,s^{\prime})\mid s_{0}=s,a_{0}=a]。 此后，如果上下文清晰，我们将省略上标 ℳ \mathcal{M}。 强化学习的目标是找到一个最优策略 π ∗ \pi^{*}，使得对于所有 s ∈ 𝖲 s\in\mathsf{S}，都有 π ∗ ( s ) = arg sup π ∈ Π V π ( s ) \pi^{*}(s)=\arg\sup_{\pi\in\Pi}V_{\pi}(s)。 我们用 V ∗ = max π ⁡ V π V^{*}=\max_{\pi}V_{\pi} 和 Q ∗ = max π ⁡ Q π Q^{*}=\max_{\pi}Q_{\pi} 来表示最优价值函数。 注意，在 Π \Pi 中总是存在一个最优策略 [ 43 ]。

sents.en: We follow the usual convention of modelling the environment as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) ℳ = ( 𝖲 , 𝖠 , 𝖲 0 , 𝐏 , 𝐑 ) \mathcal{M}=(\mathsf{S},\mathsf{A},\mathsf{S}_{0},\mathbf{P},\mathbf{R}) , where 𝖲 \mathsf{S} and 𝖠 \mathsf{A} are finite sets of states and actions respectively; 𝖲 0 ⊆ 𝖲 \mathsf{S}_{0}\subseteq\mathsf{S} is the set of initial states; 𝐏 : 𝖲 × 𝖠 → D ⁡ ( 𝖲 ) \mathbf{P}:\mathsf{S}\times\mathsf{A}\to D(\mathsf{S}) is a (generally unknown) transition kernel; and 𝐑 : 𝖲 × 𝖠 × 𝖲 → ℝ \mathbf{R}:\mathsf{S}\times\mathsf{A}\times\mathsf{S}\to\mathbb{R} is a reward function.
sents.zh: 我们遵循通常的惯例，将环境建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）ℳ = ( 𝖲 , 𝖠 , 𝖲 0 , 𝐏 , 𝐑 ) \mathcal{M}=(\mathsf{S},\mathsf{A},\mathsf{S}_{0},\mathbf{P},\mathbf{R})，其中 𝖲 \mathsf{S} 和 𝖠 \mathsf{A} 分别是状态和动作的有限集合；𝖲 0 ⊆ 𝖲 \mathsf{S}_{0}\subseteq\mathsf{S} 是初始状态的集合；𝐏 : 𝖲 × 𝖠 → D ⁡ ( 𝖲 ) \mathbf{P}:\mathsf{S}\times\mathsf{A}\to D(\mathsf{S}) 是一个（通常未知的）转移核；而 𝐑 : 𝖲 × 𝖠 × 𝖲 → ℝ \mathbf{R}:\mathsf{S}\times\mathsf{A}\times\mathsf{S}\to\mathbb{R} 是一个奖励函数。

sents.en: A solution for the RL problem can take the form of a (memoryless, stochastic) policy π : 𝖲 → D ⁡ ( 𝖠 ) \pi:\mathsf{S}\to D(\mathsf{A}) , which induces a Markov chain ℳ π \mathcal{M}_{\pi} with transition kernel 𝐏 π ​ ( s ′ | s ) = ∑ a ∈ 𝖠 π ⁡ ( a | s ) ​ 𝐏 ​ ( s ′ | s , a ) \mathbf{P}_{\pi}(s^{\prime}|s)=\sum_{a\in\mathsf{A}}\pi(a|s)\mathbf{P}(s^{\prime}|s,a) .
sents.zh: 强化学习问题的解可以表现为一个（无记忆、随机）策略 π : 𝖲 → D ⁡ ( 𝖠 ) \pi:\mathsf{S}\to D(\mathsf{A})，它诱导出一个马尔可夫链 ℳ π \mathcal{M}_{\pi}，其转移核为 𝐏 π ​ ( s ′ | s ) = ∑ a ∈ 𝖠 π ⁡ ( a | s ) ​ 𝐏 ​ ( s ′ | s , a ) \mathbf{P}_{\pi}(s^{\prime}|s)=\sum_{a\in\mathsf{A}}\pi(a|s)\mathbf{P}(s^{\prime}|s,a)。

sents.en: We let Π \Pi denote the set of memoryless policies on 𝖲 \mathsf{S} .
sents.zh: 我们用 Π \Pi 表示 𝖲 \mathsf{S} 上的无记忆策略集合。

sents.en: For a given discount factor γ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \gamma\in[0,1] , the value function of policy π \pi is the expected discount return V π ℳ ​ ( s ) = 𝔼 π ℳ ​ [ ∑ t = 0 ∞ γ t ​ 𝐑 ​ ( s t , a t , s t + 1 ) ∣ s 0 = s ] V^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}(s)=\mathbb{E}^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}\left[\sum^{\infty}_{t=0}\gamma^{t}\mathbf{R}(s_{t},a_{t},s_{t+1})\mid s_{0}=s\right] , where 𝔼 π ℳ \mathbb{E}^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi} denotes the expected value of following π \pi in ℳ \mathcal{M} .
sents.zh: 对于给定的折扣因子 γ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \gamma\in[0,1]，策略 π \pi 的价值函数是期望折扣回报 V π ℳ ​ ( s ) = 𝔼 π ℳ ​ [ ∑ t = 0 ∞ γ t ​ 𝐑 ​ ( s t , a t , s t + 1 ) ∣ s 0 = s ] V^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}(s)=\mathbb{E}^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}\left[\sum^{\infty}_{t=0}\gamma^{t}\mathbf{R}(s_{t},a_{t},s_{t+1})\mid s_{0}=s\right]，其中 𝔼 π ℳ \mathbb{E}^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi} 表示在 ℳ \mathcal{M} 中遵循策略 π \pi 的期望值。

sents.en: Similarly, the state-action value function or Q-function, is defined as Q π ℳ ( s , a ) = 𝔼 π ℳ [ ∑ t = 0 ∞ γ t R ( s , a , s ′ ) ∣ s 0 = s , a 0 = a ] Q^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}(s,a)=\mathbb{E}^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}[\sum^{\infty}_{t=0}\gamma^{t}R(s,a,s^{\prime})\mid s_{0}=s,a_{0}=a] .
sents.zh: 类似地，状态-动作价值函数或 Q 函数定义为 Q π ℳ ( s , a ) = 𝔼 π ℳ [ ∑ t = 0 ∞ γ t R ( s , a , s ′ ) ∣ s 0 = s , a 0 = a ] Q^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}(s,a)=\mathbb{E}^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi}[\sum^{\infty}_{t=0}\gamma^{t}R(s,a,s^{\prime})\mid s_{0}=s,a_{0}=a]。

sents.en: Hereafter we drop the superscript ℳ \mathcal{M} when it is clear from the context.
sents.zh: 此后，如果上下文清晰，我们将省略上标 ℳ \mathcal{M}。

sents.en: The aim of RL is to find an optimal policy π ∗ \pi^{*} such that for all s ∈ 𝖲 s\in\mathsf{S} , we have π ∗ ( s ) = arg sup π ∈ Π V π ( s ) \pi^{*}(s)=\arg\sup_{\pi\in\Pi}V_{\pi}(s) .
sents.zh: 强化学习的目标是找到一个最优策略 π ∗ \pi^{*}，使得对于所有 s ∈ 𝖲 s\in\mathsf{S}，都有 π ∗ ( s ) = arg sup π ∈ Π V π ( s ) \pi^{*}(s)=\arg\sup_{\pi\in\Pi}V_{\pi}(s)。

sents.en: We write, V ∗ = max π ⁡ V π V^{*}=\max_{\pi}V_{\pi} and Q ∗ = max π ⁡ Q π Q^{*}=\max_{\pi}Q_{\pi} to denote the optimal value functions.
sents.zh: 我们用 V ∗ = max π ⁡ V π V^{*}=\max_{\pi}V_{\pi} 和 Q ∗ = max π ⁡ Q π Q^{*}=\max_{\pi}Q_{\pi} 来表示最优价值函数。

sents.en: Note that there always exists an optimal policy in Π \Pi [ 43 ] .
sents.zh: 注意，在 Π \Pi 中总是存在一个最优策略 [ 43 ]。

paragraphs.en: We consider a set 𝖠𝖯 \mathsf{AP} of atomic propositions (or atoms). Then, Σ = P ⁡ ( 𝖠𝖯 ) \Sigma=P(\mathsf{AP}) is the alphabet over 𝖠𝖯 \mathsf{AP} (e.g., if 𝖠𝖯 = { a , b } \mathsf{AP}=\{a,b\} , then P ⁡ ( 𝖠𝖯 ) = { ∅ , { a } , { b } , { a , b } } P(\mathsf{AP})=\{\varnothing,\{a\},\{b\},\{a,b\}\} ). The labelling function 𝖫 : 𝖲 → Σ \mathsf{L}:\mathsf{S}\to\Sigma maps states to sets of atoms (intuitively, those that hold in a given state). A path is a sequence ρ = s 0 ​ s 1 ​ … ∈ 𝖲 ∞ \rho=s_{0}s_{1}\ldots\in\mathsf{S}^{\infty} of states which gives rise to a corresponding trace τ ⁡ ( ρ ) = 𝖫 ⁡ ( s 0 ) ​ 𝖫 ​ ( s 1 ) ​ … ∈ Σ ∞ \tau(\rho)=\mathsf{L}(s_{0})\mathsf{L}(s_{1})\ldots\in\Sigma^{\infty} . By standard probability theory, the transition kernel 𝐏 π \mathbf{P}_{\pi} for a policy π \pi in ℳ \mathcal{M} induces a probability measure Pr π ℳ \Pr^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi} over paths and traces in the Markov chain ℳ π \mathcal{M}_{\pi} [ 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑一个原子命题（或称原子）的集合 𝖠𝖯 \mathsf{AP}。 那么，Σ = P ⁡ ( 𝖠𝖯 ) \Sigma=P(\mathsf{AP}) 是 𝖠𝖯 \mathsf{AP} 上的字母表（例如，如果 𝖠𝖯 = { a , b } \mathsf{AP}=\{a,b\}，则 P ⁡ ( 𝖠𝖯 ) = { ∅ , { a } , { b } , { a , b } } P(\mathsf{AP})=\{\varnothing,\{a\},\{b\},\{a,b\}\}）。 标记函数 𝖫 : 𝖲 → Σ \mathsf{L}:\mathsf{S}\to\Sigma 将状态映射到原子集合（直观上，这些原子在给定状态下成立）。 一条路径是一个状态序列 ρ = s 0 ​ s 1 ​ … ∈ 𝖲 ∞ \rho=s_{0}s_{1}\ldots\in\mathsf{S}^{\infty}，它会产生一个对应的轨迹 τ ⁡ ( ρ ) = 𝖫 ⁡ ( s 0 ) ​ 𝖫 ​ ( s 1 ) ​ … ∈ Σ ∞ \tau(\rho)=\mathsf{L}(s_{0})\mathsf{L}(s_{1})\ldots\in\Sigma^{\infty}。 根据标准概率理论，策略 π \pi 在 ℳ \mathcal{M} 中的转移核 𝐏 π \mathbf{P}_{\pi} 会在马尔可夫链 ℳ π \mathcal{M}_{\pi} 的路径和轨迹上导出一个概率测度 Pr π ℳ \Pr^{\mathcal{M}}_{\pi} [ 7 ]。

paragraphs.en: Regular safety property. A linear-time property P safe ⊆ Σ ω P_{\text{safe}}\subseteq\Sigma^{\omega} is a safety property if every violating trace has a finite bad prefix , i.e., a finite word that cannot be extended to any trace in P safe P_{\text{safe}} . A safety property is regular if its set of bad prefixes forms a regular language. Equivalently, every regular safety property can be represented by a deterministic finite automaton (DFA) 𝒟 = ( 𝖰 , Σ , Δ , 𝖰 0 , ℱ ) \mathcal{D}=(\mathsf{Q},\Sigma,\Delta,\mathsf{Q}_{0},\mathcal{F}) that accepts exactly its bad prefixes. Here 𝖰 \mathsf{Q} is a finite set of states with initial state 𝖰 0 ∈ 𝖰 \mathsf{Q}_{0}\in\mathsf{Q} ; Σ \Sigma is a finite alphabet; Δ : 𝖰 × Σ → 𝖰 \Delta:\mathsf{Q}\times\Sigma\to\mathsf{Q} is the deterministic transition function; and ℱ ⊆ 𝖰 \mathcal{F}\subseteq\mathsf{Q} is the set of accepting states. A trace satisfies the safety property iff no finite prefix of the trace is accepted by 𝒟 \mathcal{D} . It is well know that for any LTL safety property there is a regular language that contains its bad prefixes [ 7 ] . Therefore, RecReg can be straightforwardly applied to LTL safety constraints.

paragraphs.en: This section details the RecReg approach for solving ( 3 ). We start by introducing a product MDP construction; defining memoryless policies on an expanded state space that preserves optimality. We then continue by formalizing probabilistic safe sets and how the backup policy is trained, followed by details regarding how the task policy is trained including a safety-aware Bellman operator that guarantees convergence. We then detail each of the three operation modes and corresponding guarantees (safety, convergence, optimality), and finally we conclude this section by providing a high level overview of RecReg applied to deep RL.
paragraphs.zh: 本节详细介绍了用于解决 ( 3 ) 的 RecReg 方法。 我们首先介绍一种乘积 MDP 构建方法；在扩展的状态空间上定义无记忆策略，同时保持最优性。 接下来，我们将对概率安全集进行形式化描述，并说明备份策略的训练方式，随后详细说明任务策略的训练过程，包括能够保证收敛性的安全感知贝尔曼算子。 然后，我们将分别阐述三种操作模式及其对应的保障（安全性、收敛性和最优性），最后通过概述 RecReg 在深度强化学习中的应用，结束本节内容。

paragraphs.en: This is where our method fundamentally departs from prior work, e.g., Recovery RL [ 49 ] . While Recovery RL also uses a separate task policy and backup or recovery policy, its recovery set is defined by a learned safety critic for the composite policy (i.e., π ◊ \pi^{\lozenge} ), and the task policy is otherwise trained to maximize task reward in the modified MDP induced by action replacement. Consequently, the safe region used for filtering actions need not coincide with S ∗ ​ ( a , ϵ ) S^{*}(a,\epsilon) , and may be a strict subset of it, leading to unnecessary interventions and an over conservative shield. In contrast with RecReg as π safe \pi_{\mathrm{safe}} converges, the shield approaches the largest set of actions that can be certified safe under the given risk budget. This distinction is important when task reward and safety are conflicting objective and allows us to obtain principled convergence and optimality guarantees for the task policy later on.
paragraphs.zh: 这正是我们的方法与先前工作（例如，Recovery RL [49]）产生根本性分歧之处。 尽管 Recovery RL 也使用一个独立的任务策略和备份或恢复策略，但其恢复集是由为组合策略（即 π ◊ \pi^{\lozenge} ）所学习的安全评判器定义的；除此之外，任务策略的训练旨在通过动作替换所引发的修改后马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中最大化任务奖励。 因此，用于过滤动作的安全区域不必与 S^{*}(a,\epsilon) 完全一致，甚至可能是其严格子集，从而导致不必要的干预和过度保守的防护机制。 与此不同，随着 π_{\mathrm{safe}} 的收敛，该防护机制会趋近于在给定风险预算下能够被认证为安全的最大动作集合。 当任务奖励与安全目标相互冲突时，这种区别至关重要，并且它使我们后续能够为任务策略获得具有理论依据的收敛性和最优性保证。

During early learning if the shield incorrectly allows unsafe actions to pass through, the task policy may get stuck proposing high-reward but unsafe actions, unless we add a corrective mechanism. paragraphs.en: In tabular RL, both the state space 𝖲 \mathsf{S} and action space 𝖠 \mathsf{A} are assumed to be of a manageable size. This setting admits explicit representations of value functions, exact or empirical transition models, and tractable verification of safety over finite horizons via probabilistic model checking [ 7 ] . We make the following central assumption for practical and theoretical reasons, which establishes that unsafe actions can be detected within a finite-horizon.
paragraphs.zh: 在表格强化学习中，状态空间 𝖲 \mathsf{S} 和行动空间 𝖠 \mathsf{A} 都被假定为具有可管理的大小。 这种设定允许对价值函数进行显式表示，支持精确或经验性的转移模型，并可通过概率模型检查在有限时间范围内对安全性进行有效验证 [ 7 ] 。 出于实际和理论上的原因，我们做出以下核心假设：不安全的行为可以在有限时间范围内被检测出来。

paragraphs.en: Similar assumptions have been made in prior work [ 50 ] which reflect many real-world invariants, such as, a car that has exceeded its minimum stopping distance will inevitably collide with an obstacle in a bounded time, and a submarine that fails to resurface will exhaust oxygen within a finite limit. In practice H ∗ H^{*} can be treated as a hyperparameter, increasing it until the desired safety probability is met, or based on prior knowledge of the environment dynamics. Often the maximum distance from initial state to accepting state in the DFA is a good heuristic. Once the minimum H ∗ H^{*} is reached, increasing it further does not affect any guarantees, but may incur additional computational overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究 [50] 也做出了类似的假设，这些假设反映了许多现实世界中的不变性，例如：一辆超过其最小制动距离的汽车必然会在有限时间内与障碍物相撞；而一艘未能浮出水面的潜艇则会在有限的时间内耗尽氧气。 在实践中，H ∗ H^{*} 可以被视为一个超参数，可以通过增加该值直到达到所需的安全概率，或者根据对环境动态的先验知识来设定。 通常，DFA 中从初始状态到接受状态的最大距离是一个很好的启发式方法。 一旦达到最小的 H ∗ H^{*}，进一步增加该值不会影响任何保证，但可能会带来额外的计算开销。

paragraphs.en: Both the task policy and safe policy are represented by Q-tables: Q task Q_{\text{task}} and Q safe Q_{\text{safe}} . At each step, an action proposed by the task policy is either executed or replaced by a backup action according to π ◊ \pi^{\lozenge} . Any rejected action is used to update Q task Q_{\text{task}} with the masked Bellman operator 𝐁 safe \mathbf{B}_{\textbf{safe}} , accumulating zero value. The executed action is used to update all Q-tables correspondingly. Algorithm 1 provides a complete overview of the procedure and we continue by addressing each operation mode individually.

paragraphs.en: While the tabular case provides a convenient framework for obtaining concrete guarantees, many interesting applications of RL consider continuous or high-dimensional environments. Results from the tabular setting still hold under the assumption of a suitably accurate dynamics (analogous to the conditions in Proposition 3 ) [ 16 , 17 ] . To utilize RecReg in these scenarios we adopt SOTA model-based RL, leveraging DreamerV3 ’s Recurrent State Space Model (RSSM) for joint dynamics learning and policy optimization [ 21 ] . The RSSM is a sequential variational auto-encoder type model that learns latent states and transition dynamics from observations. The RSSM includes a recurrent model h t = f θ ​ ( h t − 1 , z t − 1 , a t − 1 ) h_{t}=f_{\theta}(h_{t-1},z_{t-1},a_{t-1}) , an encoder z t ∼ q θ ​ ( z t ∣ o t , h t ) z_{t}\!\sim\!q_{\theta}(z_{t}\mid o_{t},h_{t}) , a prior/transition predictor z ^ t ∼ p θ ​ ( z ^ t ∣ h t ) \hat{z}_{t}\!\sim\!p_{\theta}(\hat{z}_{t}\mid h_{t}) , an observation decoder o ^ t ∼ p θ ​ ( o ^ t ∣ h t , z t ) \hat{o}_{t}\!\sim\!p_{\theta}(\hat{o}_{t}\mid h_{t},z_{t}) , a reward head r ^ t ∼ p θ ​ ( r ^ t ∣ h t , z t ) \hat{r}_{t}\!\sim\!p_{\theta}(\hat{r}_{t}\mid h_{t},z_{t}) , and a termination head γ ^ t ∼ p θ ​ ( γ ^ t ∣ h t , z t ) \hat{\gamma}_{t}\!\sim\!p_{\theta}(\hat{\gamma}_{t}\mid h_{t},z_{t}) . Similar to approximate model-based shielding (AMBS) [ 16 ] we augment the RSSM with a cost head c ^ t ∼ p θ ​ ( c ^ t ∣ h t , z t ) \hat{c}_{t}\!\sim\!p_{\theta}(\hat{c}_{t}\mid h_{t},z_{t}) to model the cost function introduced in ( 10 ). Since the RSSM summarizes history in ( h t , z t ) (h_{t},z_{t}) we can accurately learn the cost function in ( 10 ) by back-propagating its gradients through the RSSM to capture the temporal dependencies of the DFA without needing to build the product MDP or synchronize states. Both the task policy π ^ \widehat{\pi} and safe policy π safe \pi_{\text{safe}} are implemented as neural networks, with inputs derived from the RSSM latent state. To check if s ⊗ ∈ S ⁡ ( π safe , a , ϵ t ) s^{\otimes}\in S(\pi_{\text{safe}},a,\epsilon_{t}) we rollout the latent dynamics p θ p_{\theta} with a ∼ π task a\sim\pi_{\text{task}} and π safe \pi_{\text{safe}} thereafter for a fixed horizon H ∗ H^{*} , evaluating the cost head as a proxy for DFA satisfaction, and averaging over rollouts in parallel to obtain probability estimates. See Appendix B for further details.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然表格案例为获得具体保证提供了便捷的框架，但许多有趣的强化学习应用都涉及连续或高维环境。 在假设动力学模型足够精确的情况下（类似于命题3中的条件），表格设置下的结果仍然成立 [16, 17]。 为了在这些场景中使用RecReg，我们采用了当前最先进的基于模型的强化学习方法，利用DreamerV3的循环状态空间模型（RSSM）进行联合动力学学习和策略优化 [21]。 RSSM是一种序列变分自编码器类型的模型，能够从观测数据中学习潜在状态和转移动力学。 RSSM包括一个循环模型 h_t = f_θ(h_{t-1}, z_{t-1}, a_{t-1})、一个编码器 z_t ∼ q_θ(z_t | o_t, h_t)、一个先验/转移预测器 \hat{z}_t ∼ p_θ(\hat{z}_t | h_t)、一个观测解码器 \hat{o}_t ∼ p_θ(\hat{o}_t | h_t, z_t)、一个奖励头 \hat{r}_t ∼ p_θ(\hat{r}_t | h_t, z_t) 以及一个终止头 \hat{\gamma}_t ∼ p_θ(\hat{\gamma}_t | h_t, z_t)。 与近似基于模型的防护方法（AMBS）[16]类似，我们通过在RSSM中添加一个成本头 \hat{c}_t ∼ p_θ(\hat{c}_t | h_t, z_t) 来建模公式(10)中引入的成本函数。 由于RSSM将历史信息总结为(h_t, z_t)，我们可以通过反向传播其梯度穿过RSSM，准确学习公式(10)中的成本函数，从而捕捉DFA的时间依赖关系，而无需构建乘积MDP或同步状态。 任务策略 \widehat{\pi} 和安全策略 π_{\text{safe}} 都以神经网络实现，其输入来自RSSM的潜在状态。 为了验证 s^{\otimes} 是否属于 S(\pi_{\text{safe}}, a, \epsilon_t)，我们以固定时间步长 H^* 为限，使用 a ∼ π_{\text{task}} 和随后的 π_{\text{safe}} 对潜在动力学 p_θ 进行展开，将成本头作为DFA满足性的代理指标进行评估，并对并行展开的结果取平均以获得概率估计。 更多细节请参见附录B。

sents.zh: 与近似基于模型的防护方法（AMBS）[16]类似，我们通过在RSSM中添加一个成本头 \hat{c}_t ∼ p_θ(\hat{c}_t | h_t, z_t) 来建模公式(10)中引入的成本函数。

sents.en: Since the RSSM summarizes history in ( h t , z t ) (h_{t},z_{t}) we can accurately learn the cost function in ( 10 ) by back-propagating its gradients through the RSSM to capture the temporal dependencies of the DFA without needing to build the product MDP or synchronize states.
sents.zh: 由于RSSM将历史信息总结为(h_t, z_t)，我们可以通过反向传播其梯度穿过RSSM，准确学习公式(10)中的成本函数，从而捕捉DFA的时间依赖关系，而无需构建乘积MDP或同步状态。

sents.en: Both the task policy π ^ \widehat{\pi} and safe policy π safe \pi_{\text{safe}} are implemented as neural networks, with inputs derived from the RSSM latent state.
sents.zh: 任务策略 \widehat{\pi} 和安全策略 π_{\text{safe}} 都以神经网络实现，其输入来自RSSM的潜在状态。

paragraphs.en: Tabular RL. We consider a suite of tabular environments provided by MASA-Safe-RL [ 19 ] , spanning navigation and control tasks, e.g., grid worlds and Pacman. For complete environment descriptions we refer the reader to Appendix D . The environments chosen cover a range of safety properties, from simple invariants to more complex regular safety constraints specified via automata. The difficulty varies both in terms of state-space size and the complexity of the underlying safety specification. We compare RecReg against several representative safe RL approaches. Logically-Constrained RL ( LCRL ) [ 25 ] incorporates LTL constraints via reward shaping and maximal end components. QL- λ \lambda follows Lagrangian-based approaches to LTL-constrained RL, treating the penalty coefficient as a hyperparameter [ 53 , 54 , 47 ] . Safe Exploration Mask ( SEM ) [ 58 ] learns auxiliary value functions to estimate proximity to unsafe states and controllability, suppressing risky actions by renormalizing the Q function. The conceptually closest baseline is Recovery RL [ 49 ] , which learns a recovery policy to guide the agent back to safe regions although these are specified via safety critics with respect to the task policy, not the safe policy, leading to sub-optimal and overly conservative action replacement strategies. We also include three representative CMDP-based methods: PPO-Lag , TRPO-Lag [ 45 ] and CPO [ 2 ] , adapted to the tabular setting, which enforce constraints in expectation via Lagrangian and trust-region updates respectively. The main results are presented in Fig. 1 , with corresponding tabular summaries and full learning curves provided in Appendix C . Across environments, both modes of RecReg consistently achieve the desired safety probability, matching the theoretical constraint in almost all cases. Deviations primarily occur in larger state spaces, where estimation or exploration challenges arise. In contrast, baseline methods exhibit more variable safety performance, reflecting their heuristic nature or reliance on asymptotic guarantees. Even when satisfying the constraint, this often comes at the cost of reduced returns. Overall, RecReg provides a more reliable trade-off between safety and performance. Additional analyses, including runtime (across modes) and ablations (e.g., reward shaping [ 41 ] and counter factual experiences [ 29 ] ), are in Appendix C.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 表格强化学习。 我们考虑了 MASA-Safe-RL [ 19 ] 提供的一系列表格环境，涵盖导航和控制任务，例如网格世界和 Pacman。 关于环境的完整描述，请读者参考附录 D。 所选环境涵盖了多种安全属性，从简单的不变量到通过自动机指定的更复杂的常规安全约束。 其难度在状态空间大小和底层安全规范的复杂性方面均有所不同。 我们将 RecReg 与几种具有代表性的安全强化学习方法进行了比较。 逻辑约束强化学习（LCRL）[ 25 ] 通过奖励塑造和最大终态组件整合了 LTL 约束。 QL-λ \lambda 遵循基于拉格朗日法的 LTL 约束强化学习方法，将惩罚系数视为一个超参数 [ 53 , 54 , 47 ]。 安全探索掩码（SEM）[ 58 ] 学习辅助价值函数以估计与不安全状态的距离和可控性，并通过重新归一化 Q 函数来抑制风险较高的动作。 概念上最接近的基线方法是恢复强化学习 [ 49 ]，它学习一个恢复策略以将智能体引导回安全区域，尽管这些区域是相对于任务策略而非安全策略通过安全批评者指定的，这导致了次优且过于保守的动作替换策略。 我们还纳入了三种基于 CMDP 的代表性方法：PPO-Lag、TRPO-Lag [ 45 ] 和 CPO [ 2 ]，这些方法已适应表格设置，分别通过拉格朗日法和信任域更新在期望层面上强制执行约束。 主要结果展示于图 1，相应的表格摘要和完整学习曲线则提供在附录 C 中。 在所有环境中，RecReg 的两种模式均能稳定地达到所需的安全概率，几乎在所有情况下都与理论约束一致。 偏差主要出现在较大的状态空间中，此时会出现估计或探索方面的挑战。 相比之下，基线方法的安全性能表现出更大的波动，反映了其启发式特性或对渐近保证的依赖。 即使满足约束条件，这通常也会以回报降低为代价。 总体而言，RecReg 在安全与性能之间提供了更可靠的权衡。 其他分析，包括运行时间（跨模式）和消融研究（例如，奖励塑造 [ 41 ] 和反事实经验 [ 29 ]），见附录 C.3。

paragraphs.en: Distributing risk in practice. For RecReg , distributing risk across timesteps is non-trivial. A simple baseline is to allocate risk uniformly, enforcing ϵ t = ϵ / T \epsilon_{t}=\epsilon/T (where T T is the episode length), although this is typically overly conservative. A less naïve approach maintains a residual budget ϵ 0 = ϵ \epsilon_{0}=\epsilon and updates it over time; however, directly subtracting the full tail risk (i.e., ϵ t = ϵ t − 1 − ℙ π a ​ ( s t − 1 ⊗ ⊧ ◊ ​ unsafe ) \epsilon_{t}=\epsilon_{t-1}-\mathbb{P}_{\pi}^{a}(s_{t-1}^{\otimes}\models\lozenge\mathrm{unsafe}) ) leads to double-counting of future risk. Instead, we subtract only the immediate risk of violation at each step and propagate the remaining budget by conditioning on survival, yielding a more accurate and less conservative update. The immediate and tail risk can be computed exactly ( Exact ) or estimated (e.g., via ModelBased or ModelFree ). More sophisticated approaches exist, such as ProbShield , which allocates risk across successor states and preserves optimality under the global constraint ϵ \epsilon , but induces a more complex action space that is harder to optimize [ 24 ] . Treating ϵ t \epsilon_{t} as a free hyperparameter is also possible, although it sacrifices the formal guarantees of Theorem 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 实践中的风险分配。 对于 RecReg 而言，将风险分配到不同时间步并非易事。 一种简单的基线方法是将风险均匀分配，即强制要求 ϵ t = ϵ / T \epsilon_{t}=\epsilon/T（其中 T 是回合长度），但这种方法通常过于保守。 一种更合理的方法则是保留一个剩余预算 ϵ 0 = ϵ \epsilon_{0}=\epsilon，并随时间更新该预算；然而，直接减去全部尾部风险（即 ϵ t = ϵ t − 1 − ℙ π a ​ ( s t − 1 ⊗ ⊧ ◊ ​ unsafe ) \epsilon_{t}=\epsilon_{t-1}-\mathbb{P}_{\pi}^{a}(s_{t-1}^{\otimes}\models\lozenge\mathrm{unsafe}) ）会导致未来风险被重复计算。 因此，我们仅在每个步骤中减去即时的违规风险，并通过以存活为条件来传递剩余预算，从而得到更准确且保守性更低的更新方式。 即时风险和尾部风险可以精确计算（Exact），也可以进行估计（例如，通过 ModelBased 或 ModelFree）。 也存在更复杂的方法，例如 ProbShield，它会将风险分配到后续状态，并在全局约束 ϵ \epsilon 下保持最优性，但会引入一个更复杂、更难优化的动作空间 [24]。 将 ϵ t \epsilon_{t} 视为一个自由超参数也是可行的，但这会牺牲定理 1 的形式化保证。

paragraphs.en: We directly compare Exact-RecReg with ProbShield , both of which assume full knowledge of the transition dynamics and provide formal safety guarantees. Results are summarized in Table 1 . Both approaches satisfy the safety constraint across all environments (up to empirical error), ProbShield struggles as its augmented action space scales poorly in the number of actions and successor states. In contrast, RecReg ’s simpler decision structure achieves stronger returns across the board.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Exact-RecReg 与 ProbShield 进行了直接比较，这两种方法都假设完全了解转移动态，并提供了正式的安全性保证。 结果汇总于表 1。 两种方法在所有环境中都满足了安全性约束（在经验误差范围内），但 ProbShield 存在困难，因为其扩展的动作空间会随着动作数量和后续状态数量的增加而表现不佳。 相比之下，RecReg 更简单的决策结构在各个方面都实现了更高的回报。

paragraphs.en:
Deep RL. We investigate RecReg with DreamerV3’s RSSM [ 23 ] on two high-dimensional benchmarks, Atari Seaquest [ 39 ] and SafetyGym [ 45 ] (with pixel observations). The goal in Seaquest is to rescue divers while managing a limited supply of oxygen that can only be replenished at the surface. We run two separate experiments with two different safety properties φ 1 \varphi_{1} and φ 2 \varphi_{2} . The first (in LTL) φ 1 := □ ⁡ ( ( surface ∧ X ​ ¬ surface ) → □ ⁡ ( surface → diver ) ) ∧ □ ⁡ ( ¬ out-of-oxygen ) ∧ □ ⁡ ( ¬ hit ) \varphi_{1}:=\square((	exttt{surface}\land X
eg	exttt{surface})	o\square(	exttt{surface}	o	exttt{diver}))\land\square(
eg	exttt{out-of-oxygen})\land\square(
eg	exttt{hit}) , requires the agent to surface only when carrying a diver, never run out of oxygen, and avoid being hit by enemies (5 DFA-states). The second, φ 2 := □ ⁡ ( diver → ◊ ≤ 30 ​ surface ) \varphi_{2}:=\square(	exttt{diver}	o\lozenge^{\leq 30}	exttt{surface}) , requires that once a diver has been picked up, the agent must return to the surface within 30 steps (31 DFA-states). We compare with two representative baseline algorithms: DreamerV3 with the Augmented Lagrangian [ 56 ] and approximate model-based shielding (AMBS) [ 16 ] . The learning curves are presented in Figure 2 , along with tabular summaries in Appendix B . For both properties φ 1 \varphi_{1} and φ 2 \varphi_{2} , RecReg with DreamerV3 outperforms all the baselines in terms of returns while also achieving a low violation rate. Note that property φ 1 \varphi_{1} is closely aligned with “ideal” gameplay, thus the unconstrained DreamerV3 also obtains a low violation rate. Qualitative analysis can be found in the supplementary material. Due to space constraints the learning curves and results for SafetyGym are in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 深度强化学习。 我们在两个高维基准任务——Atari Seaquest [39] 和 SafetyGym [45]（使用像素观测）上，利用 DreamerV3 的 RSSM [23] 研究了 RecReg。 Seaquest 的目标是营救潜水员，同时管理有限的氧气供应，而氧气只能在水面补充。 我们进行了两组独立的实验，分别测试两种不同的安全属性 φ₁ 和 φ₂。 第一个属性（用 LTL 表示）为 φ₁ := □((surface ∧ X¬surface) → □(surface → diver)) ∧ □(¬out-of-oxygen) ∧ □(¬hit)，要求智能体只有在携带潜水员时才返回水面，绝不能耗尽氧气，且要避免被敌人击中（5 个 DFA 状态）。 第二个属性 φ₂ := □(diver → ◊≤30 surface)，要求一旦拾起潜水员，智能体必须在 30 步内返回水面（31 个 DFA 状态）。 我们将 RecReg 与两种具有代表性的基线算法进行了比较：使用增强拉格朗日法 [56] 的 DreamerV3 以及近似模型 기반 防护（AMBS）[16]。 学习曲线展示在图 2 中，表格形式的总结则见附录 B。 对于 φ₁ 和 φ₂ 这两个属性，RecReg 结合 DreamerV3 在所有基线算法中均取得了更高的回报，同时保持了较低的安全属性违反率。 需要注意的是，属性 φ₁ 与“理想”的游戏玩法高度一致，因此不受约束的 DreamerV3 也获得了较低的安全属性违反率。 定性分析可见于补充材料中。 由于篇幅限制，SafetyGym 的学习曲线和结果已移至附录 B。

sents.en: We run two separate experiments with two different safety properties φ 1 \varphi_{1} and φ 2 \varphi_{2} .
sents.zh: 我们进行了两组独立的实验，分别测试两种不同的安全属性 φ₁ 和 φ₂。

sents.en: The second, φ 2 := □ ⁡ ( diver → ◊ ≤ 30 ​ surface ) \varphi_{2}:=\square(\texttt{diver}\to\lozenge^{\leq 30}\texttt{surface}) , requires that once a diver has been picked up, the agent must return to the surface within 30 steps (31 DFA-states).
sents.zh: 第二个属性 φ₂ := □(diver → ◊≤30 surface)，要求一旦拾起潜水员，智能体必须在 30 步内返回水面（31 个 DFA 状态）。

sents.en: We compare with two representative baseline algorithms: DreamerV3 with the Augmented Lagrangian [ 56 ] and approximate model-based shielding (AMBS) [ 16 ] .
sents.zh: 我们将 RecReg 与两种具有代表性的基线算法进行了比较：使用增强拉格朗日法 [56] 的 DreamerV3 以及近似模型 기반 防护（AMBS）[16]。

sents.en: The learning curves are presented in Figure 2 , along with tabular summaries in Appendix B .
sents.zh: 学习曲线展示在图 2 中，表格形式的总结则见附录 B。

sents.en: For both properties φ 1 \varphi_{1} and φ 2 \varphi_{2} , RecReg with DreamerV3 outperforms all the baselines in terms of returns while also achieving a low violation rate.
sents.zh: 对于 φ₁ 和 φ₂ 这两个属性，RecReg 结合 DreamerV3 在所有基线算法中均取得了更高的回报，同时保持了较低的安全属性违反率。

sents.en: Note that property φ 1 \varphi_{1} is closely aligned with “ideal” gameplay, thus the unconstrained DreamerV3 also obtains a low violation rate.
sents.zh: 需要注意的是，属性 φ₁ 与“理想”的游戏玩法高度一致，因此不受约束的 DreamerV3 也获得了较低的安全属性违反率。

paragraphs.en: We introduced RecReg , a unified approach for enforcing high-probability satisfaction of regular safety properties in RL which, compared to the most closely related literature (e.g., Recovery RL [ 49 ] ), provides formal safety and convergence guarantees, with optimality under step-wise constraints. The experimental results presented in this paper validate our theoretical claims, and provide further evidence that the separation of reward and safety objectives is an effective strategy towards safety-aware decision making. Future works includes extending to our method to more RL algorithms and other scenarios (e.g., safe control, policy-gradient).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 RecReg，这是一种统一的方法，用于在强化学习（RL）中确保高概率满足常规安全属性。与最相关的文献（例如，Recovery RL [49]）相比，RecReg 提供了形式化的安全性和收敛性保证，并在逐步约束下实现了最优性。 本文提出的实验结果验证了我们的理论主张，并进一步证明了将奖励目标与安全目标分离是一种实现安全感知决策的有效策略。 未来的工作包括将我们的方法扩展到更多强化学习算法和其他场景（例如，安全控制、策略梯度）。

sents.en: We introduced RecReg , a unified approach for enforcing high-probability satisfaction of regular safety properties in RL which, compared to the most closely related literature (e.g., Recovery RL [ 49 ] ), provides formal safety and convergence guarantees, with optimality under step-wise constraints.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 RecReg，这是一种统一的方法，用于在强化学习（RL）中确保高概率满足常规安全属性。与最相关的文献（例如，Recovery RL [49]）相比，RecReg 提供了形式化的安全性和收敛性保证，并在逐步约束下实现了最优性。

sents.en: The experimental results presented in this paper validate our theoretical claims, and provide further evidence that the separation of reward and safety objectives is an effective strategy towards safety-aware decision making.

paragraphs.en: Here we provide additional implementation details including environment descriptions and training details.

paragraphs.en: Seaquest is an Atari 2600 game provided as part of the Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) [ 39 ] (c.f., Fig. 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: Seaquest 是一款由街机学习环境（ALE）[39] 提供的 Atari 2600 游戏（参见图 4）。

paragraphs.en: Dynamics: the agent (submarine) can navigate freely in the water.
paragraphs.zh: 动态：该智能体（潜艇）可以在水中自由航行。

paragraphs.en: Action space: Seaquest utilizes the full Atari controller action space (18 distinct actions), which includes all possible combinations of FIRE, UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT.
paragraphs.zh: 动作空间：Seaquest 使用了完整的 Atari 控制器动作空间（18 个独立动作），其中包括 FIRE、UP、DOWN、LEFT、RIGHT 的所有可能组合。

paragraphs.en: State space: Seaquest is partially observable, the observations correspond to 210 × 160 × 3 210\times 160\times 3 pixel images provided by the ALE. The observations are pre-processed and scaled to 64 × 64 × 3 64\times 64\times 3 tensors corresponding to pixel values with RGB information intact.
paragraphs.zh: 状态空间：Seaquest 是部分可观测的，其观察结果对应于由 ALE 提供的 210×160×3 像素图像。 观察结果经过预处理和缩放，转换为 64×64×3 张量，其中 RGB 信息的像素值得以保留。

sents.en: State space: Seaquest is partially observable, the observations correspond to 210 × 160 × 3 210\times 160\times 3 pixel images provided by the ALE.

sents.en: The observations are pre-processed and scaled to 64 × 64 × 3 64\times 64\times 3 tensors corresponding to pixel values with RGB information intact.

paragraphs.en: Additional modifications: We also use frame_skip=4 (every 4 frames are skipped with the agent’s action repeated) and sticky_actions=0.25 (there is a 0.25 chance that the agent’s previous action is repeated), which is in line with the recommended settings for Atari games [ 39 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 其他修改：我们还使用了 frame_skip=4（每 4 帧跳过一次，同时重复智能体的动作）和 sticky_actions=0.25（有 0.25 的概率重复智能体的上一次动作），这与 Atari 游戏的推荐设置一致 [39]。

sents.zh: 在我们的实验中，我们使用了三个独立的环境：PointGoal1、PointGoal2 和 CarGoal1。

sents.en: The first two environment use the Point vehicle for navigation in the environment and the third environment uses the Car vehicle.
sents.zh: 前两个环境使用 Point 车辆进行环境中的导航，而第三个环境则使用 Car 车辆。

paragraphs.en: Dynamics : the agent navigates a static environment with one of two vehicles (c.f., Fig 5 ):

paragraphs.en: Point : A simple vehicle that is constrained to the 2D plane. One actuator controls the rotation of the vehicle the other controls its linear movement. The simple control scheme makes the robot easy to control. The corresponding action space is [ − 1 , + 1 ] 2 [-1,+1]^{2} .
paragraphs.zh: 说明：一种受限于二维平面的简单车辆。 一个执行器控制车辆的旋转，另一个则控制其线性移动。 这种简单的控制方案使机器人易于操控。 相应的动作空间为 [ − 1 , + 1 ] 2 [-1,+1]^{2}。

sents.en: Point : A simple vehicle that is constrained to the 2D plane.
sents.zh: 说明：一种受限于二维平面的简单车辆。

sents.en: One actuator controls the rotation of the vehicle the other controls its linear movement.
sents.zh: 一个执行器控制车辆的旋转，另一个则控制其线性移动。

sents.en: The simple control scheme makes the robot easy to control.
sents.zh: 这种简单的控制方案使机器人易于操控。

sents.en: The corresponding action space is [ − 1 , + 1 ] 2 [-1,+1]^{2} .

paragraphs.en: Car : This vehicle exhibits more realistic dynamics, with two independently driven wheels. The mechanics are 3D, although the vehicle mostly resides in the 2D plane. The vehicle has a free moving wheel at the front that is not connected to any actuators. The control scheme is a little more advanced since, rotating, and moving forward and backwards require coordination between the two driven wheels. However, the action space is identical, i.e. [ − 1 , + 1 ] 2 [-1,+1]^{2} .
paragraphs.zh: 汽车：这辆车表现出更真实的动态特性，拥有两个可独立驱动的车轮。 其力学模型是三维的，尽管车辆主要处于二维平面内。 车辆前部有一个可以自由移动的车轮，该车轮未与任何执行器相连。 控制方案稍显复杂，因为旋转以及前后移动都需要两个驱动轮之间的协调配合。 然而，动作空间是相同的，即： [ − 1 , + 1 ] 2 [-1,+1]^{2} 。

paragraphs.en: We has access to 2 NVIDIA Tesla A40 (48GB RAM) GPU and a 24-core/48 thread Intel Xeon CPU each with 32GB-64GB of additional RAM. Each run for Atari Seaquest can take 8 hours to 1 day (per seed) depending on the exact configuration of DreamerV3, in general we see a slow down of factor of roughly 2 when using AMBS and RecReg compared to the unmodified DreamerV3 baseline. Memory requirements may differ depending on the DreamerV3 configuration used, for the xlarge configuration 32GB of GPU memory will suffice.
paragraphs.zh: 我们拥有 2 块 NVIDIA Tesla A40（48GB RAM）GPU 和一颗 24 核/48 线程的 Intel Xeon CPU，每块 GPU 还配有 32GB-64GB 的额外 RAM。 每次运行 Atari Seaquest 可能需要 8 小时到 1 天（每个种子），具体取决于 DreamerV3 的确切配置；总体而言，与未修改的 DreamerV3 基线相比，使用 AMBS 和 RecReg 时速度会下降约 2 倍。 内存需求可能因使用的 DreamerV3 配置而异；对于 xlarge 配置，32GB GPU 内存就足够了。

paragraphs.en: AMBS and Deep-RecReg are almost inseparable with markedly similar performance profiles. Both achieve relatively low violation rates but do not achieve the best returns. Broadly speaking Deep-RecReg achieves slightly better returns but slightly higher violation rates compared with AMBS across the board. On the other end of the spectrum, the unconstrained DreamerV3 achieves the highest returns but does not meaningfully reduce safety violations. The Augmented Lagrangian has a harder time at reducing safety violations likely due to fluctuating penalties but achieves higher returns than both AMBS and Deep-RecReg .
paragraphs.zh: AMBS 和 Deep-RecReg 几乎不可分割，其性能表现极为相似。 两者都实现了相对较低的违规率，但未能达到最佳回报。 总体而言，与 AMBS 相比，Deep-RecReg 的回报略高，但违规率也略高。 在另一极端，无约束的 DreamerV3 实现了最高的回报，但并未显著减少安全违规。 增广拉格朗日方法在减少安全违规方面面临更大困难，这可能是因为惩罚项存在波动，但其回报高于 AMBS 和 Deep-RecReg。

sents.en: AMBS and Deep-RecReg are almost inseparable with markedly similar performance profiles.
sents.zh: AMBS 和 Deep-RecReg 几乎不可分割，其性能表现极为相似。

sents.en: Both achieve relatively low violation rates but do not achieve the best returns.
sents.zh: 两者都实现了相对较低的违规率，但未能达到最佳回报。

sents.en: Broadly speaking Deep-RecReg achieves slightly better returns but slightly higher violation rates compared with AMBS across the board.
sents.zh: 总体而言，与 AMBS 相比，Deep-RecReg 的回报略高，但违规率也略高。

sents.en: On the other end of the spectrum, the unconstrained DreamerV3 achieves the highest returns but does not meaningfully reduce safety violations.
sents.zh: 在另一极端，无约束的 DreamerV3 实现了最高的回报，但并未显著减少安全违规。

sents.en: The Augmented Lagrangian has a harder time at reducing safety violations likely due to fluctuating penalties but achieves higher returns than both AMBS and Deep-RecReg .
sents.zh: 增广拉格朗日方法在减少安全违规方面面临更大困难，这可能是因为惩罚项存在波动，但其回报高于 AMBS 和 Deep-RecReg。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a simple ablation study for Colour Bomb Gridworld V2 with Property 2 . The DFA for Property 2 has 22 states, meaning the product MDP has 22 times more states than the original MDP. In particular, we ablate the use of counter factual experiences [ 29 ] for training the task and safe policy. We also investigate the effect of two reward shaping mechanisms based on the idea of potential-based reward shaping [ 41 ] . First we provide a primer.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对具有属性 2 的 Colour Bomb Gridworld V2 进行了一项简单的消融研究。 属性 2 的 DFA 包含 22 个状态，这意味着生成的 MDP 的状态数量是原始 MDP 的 22 倍。 具体来说，我们在任务训练和安全策略的训练中移除了反事实经验 [29] 的使用。 我们还研究了两种基于势函数奖励塑造 [41] 思想的奖励塑造机制的效果。 首先，我们提供一个简要介绍。

paragraphs.en: Intuitively the value function v : 𝖰 → ℝ v:\mathsf{Q}\to\mathbb{R} essentially assigns automaton states that are closer to the accepting state with higher values. This in turn penalized the agent for moving closer to the accepting state in the automaton.

paragraphs.en: This approach is inspired by cycle experience replay [ 47 ] which was used for full LTL constraints. The approach is as follows, we first compute the length shortest path through the DFA 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , from each automaton state q ∈ 𝖰 q\in\mathsf{Q} to the initial state 𝖰 0 \mathsf{Q}_{0} , e.g., via breadth-first search. Each automaton state q ∈ 𝖰 q\in\mathsf{Q} is assigned a value v ⁡ ( q ) v(q) which corresponds to the length of the shortest path from q q to 𝖰 0 \mathsf{Q}_{0} , which will be used for potential-based reward shaping. This provides an incentive to the agent to return to the initial state 𝖰 0 \mathsf{Q}_{0} as quickly as possible (short cycles), while avoiding the accepting states of the DFA 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , which are sink nodes, i.e. v ⁡ ( q ) = ∞ ​ ∀ q ∈ ℱ v(q)=\infty\;\forall q\in\mathcal{F} . Again, the cost function is redefined as in ( 34 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这种方法受到循环经验重放 [47] 的启发，该方法曾被用于完整的 LTL 约束。 具体方法如下：我们首先通过 DFA 𝒟 \mathcal{D} 计算从每个自动机状态 q ∈ 𝖰 q\in\mathsf{Q} 到初始状态 𝖰 0 \mathsf{Q}_{0} 的最短路径长度，例如通过广度优先搜索。 每个自动机状态 q ∈ 𝖰 q\in\mathsf{Q} 都被赋予一个值 v⁡(q) v(q)，该值对应于从 q q 到 𝖰 0 \mathsf{Q}_{0} 的最短路径长度，并将用于基于势能的奖励塑造。 这激励智能体尽快返回初始状态 𝖰 0 \mathsf{Q}_{0}（即形成较短的循环），同时避免 DFA 𝒟 \mathcal{D} 的接受状态——这些状态是汇点，即 v⁡(q) = ∞ ​ ∀ q ∈ ℱ v(q)=\infty\;\forall q\in\mathcal{F}。 同样，成本函数也如 (34) 中那样重新定义。

paragraphs.en: Figure 22 provides the learning curves for RecReg-ModelFree with the two different potential-based reward shaping approaches. First we see that without counter-factual experiences (CFE) the algorithm struggles to converge quickly and achieves a low safety probability due to slower convergence of the safe policy. Automated (Potential) reward shaping destabilizes learning slightly and the algorithm converges suboptimally, whereas cycle-based reward shaping improves learning stability and converges optimally.
paragraphs.zh: 图22展示了RecReg-ModelFree在两种不同的基于势能的奖励塑造方法下的学习曲线。 首先可以看到，在没有反事实经验（CFE）的情况下，该算法难以快速收敛，并且由于安全策略的收敛速度较慢，导致安全概率较低。 自动（势能）奖励塑造会轻微破坏学习的稳定性，并使算法以次优方式收敛；而基于循环的奖励塑造则能提升学习稳定性，并实现最优收敛。

sents.zh: 图22展示了RecReg-ModelFree在两种不同的基于势能的奖励塑造方法下的学习曲线。

paragraphs.en: Figure 23 provides the learning curves for QL- λ \lambda with the two different potential-based reward shaping approaches. Again we see that without counter-factual experiences (CFE) the algorithm struggles to converge quickly. However, in contrast to before both automated (Potential) and reward shaping fully destabilizes learning collapsing the policy to the safest possibly policy (no reward). Whereas cycle-based reward shaping improves both safety and task performance uniformly finding the right balance. This highlights the difficulty with tuning Lagrangian approaches like QL- λ \lambda , subtle shifts in the cost function and penalty magnitudes can break the balance between task performance and safety.
paragraphs.zh: 图 23 展示了采用两种不同基于势能的奖励塑造方法时，QL-λ 的学习曲线。 我们再次看到，如果没有反事实经验（CFE），该算法难以快速收敛。 然而，与之前不同，自动化方法（Potential）和奖励塑造都会完全破坏学习稳定性，使策略退化为最安全的可行策略（无奖励）。 而基于循环的奖励塑造则能均匀地提升安全性和任务表现，找到恰当的平衡点。 这凸显了调整 QL-λ 这类拉格朗日方法所面临的困难：成本函数和惩罚强度的细微变化就可能打破任务表现与安全之间的平衡。

paragraphs.en: Running a model checking routine at each decision making step inevitable incurs some non-trivial computational overhead. This overhead grows as the size of the MDP or DFA increases. In Tab. 7 we provide a quick runtime comparison for the different operation mode of RecReg on environments of varying size. For reference Exact and ModelFree operate at roughly the same speed as the other mode-free tabular baselines (e.g., Q-learning).
paragraphs.zh: 在每个决策步骤中运行模型检查程序，不可避免地会产生一些非微不足道的计算开销。 随着马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）或确定有限自动机（DFA）规模的增大，这种开销也会随之增长。 在表 7 中，我们对 RecReg 在不同环境规模下的不同操作模式进行了快速运行时比较。 作为参考，Exact 和 ModelFree 的运行速度大致与其他无模式表格基线方法（例如 Q-learning）相当。

paragraphs.en: The environment models a simple data-buffer management task, where the agent must regulate packet inflow to prevent buffer underflow.
paragraphs.zh: 该环境模拟了一个简单数据缓冲区管理任务，其中智能体必须调节数据包流入，以防止缓冲区欠流。

paragraphs.en: Dynamics: packets leave in the data-buffer according to a Bernoulli process with rate μ out = 0.7 \mu_{\text{out}}=0.7 .
paragraphs.zh: 动态：数据包根据一个速率 μ out = 0.7 \mu_{\text{out}}=0.7 的伯努利过程从数据缓冲区中离开。

paragraphs.en: Action space: 𝖠 = { fast , slow } \mathsf{A}=\{\textit{fast},\textit{slow}\}
paragraphs.zh: 动作空间：𝖠 = { fast , slow } \mathsf{A}=\{\textit{fast},\textit{slow}\}

paragraphs.en: fast adds new packets with rate μ fast = 0.9 \mu_{\textit{fast}}=0.9 .
paragraphs.zh: 快速智能体以速率 μ fast = 0.9 添加新数据包，即 μ_{\textit{fast}}=0.9。

paragraphs.en: slow adds new packets with rate μ slow = 0.1 \mu_{\textit{slow}}=0.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 慢速智能体以速率 μ slow = 0.1 添加新数据包，即 μ_{\textit{slow}}=0.1。

paragraphs.zh: 奖励函数：当智能体选择快速行动时，会获得 −1.0 的惩罚。

In this environment the agent acts in a 9 × 9 9\times 9 “slippery” gridworld (c.f., Fig. 27 ) with a 0.1 0.1 chance that the agent’s action is ignored and another action is uniformly sampled.
paragraphs.zh: MASA 中此环境的访问点位于 env id: colour_bomb_gridworld_v2 下。 在此环境中，智能体在一个 9 × 9 的“滑溜”网格世界中行动（参见图 27），其中存在 0.1 的概率导致智能体的动作被忽略，并由另一个动作均匀采样替代。

sents.en: The access point for this environment in MASA is under the env id: colour_bomb_gridworld_v2 .
sents.zh: MASA 中此环境的访问点位于 env id: colour_bomb_gridworld_v2 下。

sents.en: In this environment the agent acts in a 9 × 9 9\times 9 “slippery” gridworld (c.f., Fig. 27 ) with a 0.1 0.1 chance that the agent’s action is ignored and another action is uniformly sampled.
sents.zh: 在此环境中，智能体在一个 9 × 9 的“滑溜”网格世界中行动（参见图 27），其中存在 0.1 的概率导致智能体的动作被忽略，并由另一个动作均匀采样替代。

paragraphs.en: Dynamics: typical gridworld dynamics with slip probability 0.1 0.1 . After entering a coloured goal state, the agent transitions to a random starting ( S ) state.
paragraphs.zh: 动态：典型的网格世界动态，滑移概率为 0.1 0.1。 进入带颜色的目标状态后，智能体会转移到随机的初始状态（S）。

sents.en: Dynamics: typical gridworld dynamics with slip probability 0.1 0.1 .
sents.zh: 动态：典型的网格世界动态，滑移概率为 0.1 0.1。

sents.en: After entering a coloured goal state, the agent transitions to a random starting ( S ) state.
sents.zh: 进入带颜色的目标状态后，智能体会转移到随机的初始状态（S）。

paragraphs.en: State space: 15 × 15 15\times 15 different locations in the gridworld ⇒ | 𝖲 | = 225 \Rightarrow|\mathsf{S}|=225 .
paragraphs.zh: 状态空间：网格世界中 15 × 15 的不同位置 ⇒ | 𝖲 | = 225 \Rightarrow|\mathsf{S}|=225。

paragraphs.en: Reward function: The agent receives a reward of 1.0 1.0 when entering the (non-terminal) coloured states blue , pink , red , green or yellow states.
paragraphs.zh: 奖励函数：当智能体进入（非终止的）蓝色、粉色、红色、绿色或黄色等彩色状态时，将获得 1.0 的奖励。

paragraphs.en: Property 3: If a B state is reached the agent must reach a M state and remain there for 2 timesteps all within 10 timesteps ( φ = B → ◊ ≤ 10 ​ ( M → ( X ​ M ) ) \varphi=\texttt{B}\to\lozenge^{\leq 10}(\texttt{M}\to(X\texttt{M})) ).
paragraphs.zh: 性质3：如果达到一个 B 状态，智能体必须达到一个 M 状态，并在该状态下停留 2 个时间步，且所有这些都必须在 10 个时间步内完成（φ = B → ◊ ≤ 10 ​ ( M → ( X ​ M ) ) \varphi=\texttt{B}\to\lozenge^{\leq 10}(\texttt{M}\to(X\texttt{M}))）。

paragraphs.en: Automaton size: | 𝖰 | = 2 |\mathsf{Q}|=2 for Property 1, | 𝖰 | = 4 |\mathsf{Q}|=4 for Property 2 and | 𝖰 | = 22 |\mathsf{Q}|=22 for Property 3.
paragraphs.zh: 自动机规模：属性 1 中 | 𝖰 | = 2 |\mathsf{Q}|=2，属性 2 中 | 𝖰 | = 4 |\mathsf{Q}|=4，属性 3 中 | 𝖰 | = 22 |\mathsf{Q}|=22。

paragraphs.en: RecReg (lower-bound): 1 − ϵ = 0.975 1-\epsilon=0.975 .
paragraphs.zh: RecReg（下界）：1 − ϵ = 0.975 1-\epsilon=0.975。

paragraphs.en: PPO-Lag / CPO (cost upper-bound): 0.025 0.025 .
paragraphs.zh: PPO-Lag / CPO（成本上限）：0.025 0.025 .

paragraphs.en: Rec. RL (step-wise upper-bound): ϵ t = 0.0001 \epsilon_{t}=0.0001 .
paragraphs.zh: 推荐。 RL（逐步上界）：ϵ t = 0.0001 \epsilon_{t}=0.0001 。

sents.en: Rec.
sents.zh: 推荐。

sents.en: RL (step-wise upper-bound): ϵ t = 0.0001 \epsilon_{t}=0.0001 .
sents.zh: RL（逐步上界）：ϵ t = 0.0001 \epsilon_{t}=0.0001 。

paragraphs.en: Model checking horizon: H = 9 H=9 for Property 1 and 2; H = 12 H=12 for Property 3.
paragraphs.zh: 模型检查时间范围：属性 1 和 2 的 H = 9 H=9；属性 3 的 H = 12 H=12。

paragraphs.en: The agent (Pacman) operates in a Pacman world, with one ghost and one piece of food (yellow circle) to collect (c.f., Fig. 28 ). The agent can exit via the bottom right hand corner, although from the initial configuration the ghost is likely to catch the agent if it heads straight for the food or exit.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体（Pacman）在 Pacman 世界中运行，其中有一个幽灵和一个需要收集的食物（黄色圆圈）（参见图 28）。 智能体可以通过右下角离开，但从初始配置来看，如果它径直走向食物或出口，很可能会被幽灵抓住。

sents.en: The agent (Pacman) operates in a Pacman world, with one ghost and one piece of food (yellow circle) to collect (c.f., Fig. 28 ).
sents.zh: 智能体（Pacman）在 Pacman 世界中运行，其中有一个幽灵和一个需要收集的食物（黄色圆圈）（参见图 28）。

sents.en: The agent can exit via the bottom right hand corner, although from the initial configuration the ghost is likely to catch the agent if it heads straight for the food or exit.
sents.zh: 智能体可以通过右下角离开，但从初始配置来看，如果它径直走向食物或出口，很可能会被幽灵抓住。

paragraphs.en: Dynamics: typical Pacman dynamics: can only change direction at an intersection and turn around when facing a wall. The ghost follows the path with shortest Manhattan distance to the agent at every point, but with probability 0.6 picks a random action.
paragraphs.zh: 动态：典型的 Pacman 动态：只能在路口改变方向，面对墙壁时会掉头。 幽灵在每个点都沿着到智能体的曼哈顿距离最短的路径移动，但有 0.6 的概率选择随机动作。

sents.en: Dynamics: typical Pacman dynamics: can only change direction at an intersection and turn around when facing a wall.
sents.zh: 动态：典型的 Pacman 动态：只能在路口改变方向，面对墙壁时会掉头。

sents.en: The ghost follows the path with shortest Manhattan distance to the agent at every point, but with probability 0.6 picks a random action.
sents.zh: 幽灵在每个点都沿着到智能体的曼哈顿距离最短的路径移动，但有 0.6 的概率选择随机动作。

paragraphs.en: Action space: 𝖠 = { Left , Right , Up , Down , No-Change } \mathsf{A}=\{\textit{Left},\textit{Right},\textit{Up},\textit{Down},\textit{No-Change}\}
paragraphs.zh: 动作空间：𝖠 = { 左 , 右 , 上 , 下 , 不变 } \mathsf{A}=\{\textit{左},\textit{右},\textit{上},\textit{下},\textit{不变}\}

paragraphs.en: State space: Accounting for all valid configurations for the Pacman’s location, direction and the ghost’s location and direction, there are precisely 8124 game states ⇒ | 𝖲 | = 8124 \Rightarrow|\mathsf{S}|=8124 .
paragraphs.zh: 状态空间：考虑到 Pacman 的位置、方向以及幽灵的位置和方向的所有有效组合，恰好存在 8124 种游戏状态 ⇒ | 𝖲 | = 8124 \Rightarrow|\mathsf{S}|=8124 。

paragraphs.en: Reward function: The agent receives a reward of 1.0 1.0 when it enters the location with the food present (c.f., Fig. 28 ); once the food is picked up it disappears.
paragraphs.zh: 奖励函数：当智能体进入有食物的位置时，会获得 1.0 的奖励（参见图 28）；一旦食物被拾起，就会消失。

paragraphs.en: Episode length: T = 100 T=100 (no termination upon collecting the food, but can terminate via the exit).
paragraphs.zh: 回合长度：T = 100 T=100（收集食物时不会终止，但可以通过出口终止）。

paragraphs.en: Safety property: The agent must avoid the ghost for the entire duration of the episode, even after picking up the food ( φ = □ ​ ¬ ghost \varphi=\square\neg\,\text{ghost} )
paragraphs.zh: 安全性属性：在整个回合期间，智能体必须始终避开幽灵，即使在捡起食物之后也是如此（ φ = □ ​ ¬ ghost \varphi=\square\neg\,\text{ghost} ）

paragraphs.en: The tabular environments are provided by MASA-Safe-RL [ 19 ] (MIT license) and implemented with Gymnasium [ 52 ] (MIT license). Tabular Q-learning is implemented with numpy in Python , the model checking procedures (both exact and statistical) are implemented with JAX [ 11 ] (Apache-2.0 license) which supports vectorized computation on GPU and CPU. For PPO-Lag [ 45 ] and CPO [ 2 ] , we use the implementations provided by Omnisafe [ 33 ] , the code for running these benchmarks is mostly public facing at https://github.com/sacktock/MASA-Safe-RL our private code can also be made available upon reasonable request, for setup instructions please refer to the Omnisafe code base https://github.com/PKU-Alignment/omnisafe (Apache-2.0 license).
paragraphs.zh: 表格环境由 MASA-Safe-RL [ 19 ]（MIT 许可证）提供，并使用 Gymnasium [ 52 ]（MIT 许可证）实现。 表格 Q-learning 使用 Python 中的 numpy 实现，模型检查过程（精确和统计两种）则使用 JAX [ 11 ]（Apache-2.0 许可证）实现，该库支持在 GPU 和 CPU 上进行向量化计算。 对于 PPO-Lag [ 45 ] 和 CPO [ 2 ]，我们使用了 Omnisafe [ 33 ] 提供的实现；运行这些基准测试的代码大部分可在 https://github.com/sacktock/MASA-Safe-RL 公开获取，我们的私有代码也可在合理请求后提供。有关设置说明，请参阅 Omnisafe 代码库 https://github.com/PKU-Alignment/omnisafe（Apache-2.0 许可证）。

paragraphs.en: For collecting all sets of experiments we has access to 2 NVIDIA Tesla A40 (48GB RAM) GPU and a 24-core/48 thread Intel Xeon CPU each with 32GB of additional RAM. Each run for the tabular experiments can take anywhere from several minutes to several hours depending on the number of training steps and the complexity of the environment or safety property being used.
paragraphs.zh: 为了收集所有可用的实验数据集，我们配备了 2 块 NVIDIA Tesla A40（48GB RAM）GPU 和一颗 24 核/48 线程的 Intel Xeon CPU，每块 GPU 还配有 32GB 额外内存。 表格实验的每次运行所需时间可能从几分钟到几个小时不等，具体取决于训练步数以及所用环境或安全属性的复杂程度。

paragraphs.en: Standard error (SE) intervals are provided in Table 5 & 6 for each of our experiments. In particular, we report 10 random initializations (seeds) for each experiment. In the learning curves (c.f., Section C.1 ) and bar charts (c.f., Figure 1 ), we plot the non-parametric (bootstrap) 95% confidence intervals, provided by seaborn.lineplot with default parameters: errorbar=(‘ci’, 95), n_boot=1000 . The error bars capture the randomness in the initialization of the policy parameters and batch sampling (e.g., for PPO-Lag and CPO), and any randomness in the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 表 5 和表 6 中给出了我们每次实验的标准误差（SE）区间。 具体来说，我们对每次实验报告了 10 个随机初始化（种子）。 在学习曲线（参见 C.1 节）和柱状图（参见图 1）中，我们绘制了非参数（自助法）95% 置信区间，该区间由 seaborn.lineplot 使用默认参数生成：errorbar=('ci', 95), n_boot=1000。 误差棒反映了策略参数初始化和批量采样中的随机性（例如，对于 PPO-Lag 和 CPO），以及环境中任何随机性。

sents.en: Standard error (SE) intervals are provided in Table 5 & 6 for each of our experiments.
sents.zh: 表 5 和表 6 中给出了我们每次实验的标准误差（SE）区间。

sents.en: In particular, we report 10 random initializations (seeds) for each experiment.
sents.zh: 具体来说，我们对每次实验报告了 10 个随机初始化（种子）。

sents.en: In the learning curves (c.f., Section C.1 ) and bar charts (c.f., Figure 1 ), we plot the non-parametric (bootstrap) 95% confidence intervals, provided by seaborn.lineplot with default parameters: errorbar=(‘ci’, 95), n_boot=1000 .
sents.zh: 在学习曲线（参见 C.1 节）和柱状图（参见图 1）中，我们绘制了非参数（自助法）95% 置信区间，该区间由 seaborn.lineplot 使用默认参数生成：errorbar=('ci', 95), n_boot=1000。

sents.en: The error bars capture the randomness in the initialization of the policy parameters and batch sampling (e.g., for PPO-Lag and CPO), and any randomness in the environment.
